article.headline: Oral Roberts secures 72-66 victory against Missouri State
article.description: — Luke Gray’s 15 points helped Oral Roberts defeat Missouri State 72-66 on Friday.
article.linkText: Oral Roberts secures 72-66 victory against Missouri State

categories.description: Missouri State Bears @ Oral Roberts Golden Eagles

event.description: Missouri State Bears @ Oral Roberts Golden Eagles

keywords: Missouri State Bears @ Oral Roberts Golden Eagles
article.story: TULSA, Okla. -- — Luke Gray’s 15 points helped Oral Roberts defeat Missouri State 72-66 on Friday. Gray shot 6 for 12 (2 for 3 from 3-point range) and 1 of 4 from the free-throw line for the Golden Eagles (5-3). Connor Dow added 14 points while going 4 of 10 (4 for 8 from 3-point range) with eight rebounds and three blocks. Chase Martin shot 5 of 6 from the field and 3 of 5 from the free-throw line to finish with 13 points. Trey Williams Jr. led the Bears (5-1) in scoring, finishing with 19 points. Missouri State also got 16 points and 13 rebounds from Andrej Acimovic. Melakih Cunningham had 11 points and six rebounds. The loss broke the Bears’ five-game winning streak. Gray scored 12 points in the first half and Oral Roberts went into halftime trailing 39-36. Oral Roberts used a 10-0 second-half run to break a 54-54 tie and take the lead at 64-54 with 5:39 remaining in the half. Boden Williams scored nine second-half points for the Golden Eagles. Up next Oral Roberts takes on Creighton on the road on Tuesday, and Missouri State hosts Lindenwood on Monday. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
